standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-carry.player: I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-carry.text: If the player hasn't claimed their rewards yet and is on a free-to-play world:

steps.npc: Why yes, here are some air and mind runes.
I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.

steps.text: Continues as if the player weren't carrying a Combat path voucher

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-carry.text: If the player hasn't claimed their member rewards yet and is on a free-to-play world:

steps.npc: I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.

steps.text: Continues as if the player weren't carrying a Combat path voucher

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-isn-t-ca.npc: Do you want to buy some runes?

options.text: Can you tell me about your cape?

steps.npc: Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
The Cape of Runecrafting has been upgraded with each talisman, allowing you to access all Runecrafting altars. Is there anything else I can help you with?

options.text: I'd like to view your store please.

steps.npc: Well, if you find someone who does want runes, please send them my way.

options.text: Oh, it's a rune shop. No thank you, then.

steps.player: Oh, it's a rune shop. No thank you, then.

steps.npc: Well, if you find someone who does want runes, please send them my way.

options.text: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
options.condition: If the player has completed Rune Mysteries:

steps.player: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?

steps.npc: Of course. By the way, if you end up making any runes from the essence you mine, I'll happily buy them from you.

steps.text: Aubury teleports the player to the rune essence mine
